name: Almost Heaven Essex 4-Person Barrel Sauna, 7x6 ft.
description: Almost Heaven Essex 4-Person Barrel Sauna, 7x6 ft. The popular Essex barrel sauna comfortably seats 4 people. Coming standard with the Harvia KIP80B 8 kW heater, it is large enough to host our more powerful heaters, both electric and wood-burning! (The Essex is the smallest Almost Heaven barrel sauna that can accommodate a wood-burning stove.) The Almost Heaven Essex barrel sauna combines the rustic charm of a barrel design with cutting-edge technology. With enough space for four, it's perfect for sharing precious moments with friends and family. The natural cedar wood not only exudes a soothing aroma but also ensures durability for years to come. Features Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8" thick Any glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED Light Sauna Stones included Weather-proof polymer support cradles Two opposite facing benches for sitting or reclining Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Best-in-class heater & sauna stones Limited Lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements. Made in the USA Specifications Holds up to four people Standard heater size: 8 kW, 240V, 40-amp requirement, hardwire connect Lighting Electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled size: 82-3/8"W x 72"D x 85-7/8"H Interior Room Size: 79"W x 64"D x 79-5/8"H Interior Bench Dimensions: 20"W x 64"L x 22"H Cradle Dimensions: 57"W x 6"L Shipping Weight: 1180 lbs Shipping Size: 48"W x 88"L x 50"H Customizations Window Type: Standard Solid Wall - Ultimate privacy and insulation. Vista Window - Add a panoramic view to enjoy the beautiful landscape outside your sauna! Neatly set into the back panel with CNC precision, the 20" x 40" Vista Window allows the natural surroundings to amplify the relaxation in your sauna. If you have a mountain, river, lake, ocean, field, forest, or other within view of your sauna, the Vista Window is for you! Port Window - Ahoy! Adding the Port Window to your sauna gives it an especially nautical feel, and allows you to feel cozy while being able to view the elements outside. It also permits a perfect amount of natural light to illuminate the interior of your sauna, making it feel more open. This classy window is a wonderful addition to your barrel sauna! Door Type: Glass Door - The standard door for our Almost Heaven indoor or outdoor saunas is the glass door. The tempered glass door allows for an open and spacious atmosphere inside of your sauna. Also included is a cylindrical stainless-steel handle. The large, easy to open handle is designed with smooth wood on the interior and stylish stainless steel on the exterior. The wooden handle stays cool while the sauna heats up,, and the stainless steel adds an elegant contrast to the natural wood of your sauna. Wood Door With Window - A perfect balance of added insulation and ambient light, it's ideal for locations that see near or below freezing temperatures. Keep your heat in with this upgrade! Heater Type: Comes standard with the 8 kW KIP with built-in-controls Can be upgraded to a number of heaters, scroll up to see the available options! Lighting Type: Comes standard with a white LED light (30") Can be upgraded to the color-changing LED Mood Light Shipping We choose to ship this via flatbed, however, it can ship LTL upon request. Care and Maintenance Same as all other barrel saunas! Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Read more about long-term care and maintenance here. Assembly Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Useful Link Barrel Sauna Installation and Owner's Manual Videos
